classes.title: Classes
classes.body: At the top of the page you switch to another class or create a new one.

add.title: Adding students
add.body: One by one, as placeholders or from a CSV file – under “Add” and “Manage” in the toolbar.

edit.title: Editing a student
edit.body: A click on a student opens them in the inspector. All data stays on this device only.

partners.title: Preferred and distance partners
partners.body: Up to three per student – the first one counts most.

several.title: Editing several
several.body: Select several students to edit them together.

views.title: Attributes and relationships
views.body: In “Attributes” the whole class is asked about one attribute after another, “Relationships” shows every partner wish.

setup.title: Setting up the room
setup.body: With nothing selected, “Set up from scratch” in the inspector places tables for the whole class.

add.title: Tables and room elements
add.body: A click in “Add” puts one on a free spot – or you drag it into the room.

move.title: Moving and turning
move.body: Drag the selection into place and turn it by its handle. Shift+click or a frame selects several.

edit.title: Editing
edit.body: Edit what is selected in the inspector or with a right-click – with a long press on a tablet or a phone.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: A class can have several rooms: “New room” and “Open a room …” are in the inspector while nothing is selected.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Under “Templates” in the inspector you save the room for other classes or open a saved one.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.body: In the inspector you set how much each criterion matters – or pick a preset such as “Written test”.

save.title: Saving
save.body: Name the plan at the top of the inspector and keep it with “Save plan”.

seats.title: Swapping and locking seats
seats.body: Drag students to other seats. A seat's lock keeps its student out of the next mix.

fulfilment.title: Fulfilment
fulfilment.body: “Fulfilment” in the status bar shows how well each criterion is met – a click on one marks the seats it concerns.

badges.title: Markers
badges.body: Hover over or tap an icon on a seat: it explains itself and marks everyone who shares it.

view.title: View
view.body: Under “View settings” you choose how names, photos and markers appear; the legend is there too.

origin.title: From the seating plan
origin.body: The circle is built from the seating plan. “Shuffle” orders it at random, “Align” brings it back.

seats.title: Swapping and locking places
seats.body: Drag students to other places. The lock keeps students out of shuffling and aligning.

connections.title: Connections
connections.body: The lines show table neighbours from the seating plan; the inspector shows how many sit side by side.

save.title: Saving
save.body: “Save plan” in the inspector keeps the circle together with the plan.

views.title: View
views.body: In the toolbar you choose the seating plan or the circle, the “List” with room for notes, the sheet for a “Substitute” or “Name cards” for desk and jumper.

sheetTitle.title: Title
sheetTitle.body: A click on the title at the top of the inspector changes it for the export only, not the plan's name.

format.title: Page format
format.body: Portrait or landscape; “From the back” turns the room for a desk at the back.

content.title: Preview
content.body: In the inspector you set how names appear and what the export shows – from photos to room elements.

save.title: Printing and saving
save.body: “Print” is in the status bar; save as PDF, PNG or SVG from the toolbar.

studentView.title: Student view
studentView.body: Shows the plan from the class's side, without markers and photos.

display.title: Showing and hiding
display.body: Switch markers, photos, names, room and colours in the bar at the bottom.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.body: Black on white with strong lines – easy to read in a bright room.

size.title: Size
size.body: The slider, the mouse wheel or two fingers zoom, dragging pans; “Recentre” resets the view.

pick.title: Who's next?
pick.body: Draws a random student and spotlights their seat – everyone gets a turn before anyone repeats.

absent.title: Missing today
absent.body: Tap a seat when someone is missing: the seat fades, and "Who’s next?" and "Build groups" leave them out. It lasts for today and is never stored.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
fullscreen.body: The bar at the bottom slides away; point at or tap the bottom edge to bring it back.

columns.title: Columns
columns.body: Your classes, room templates and presets are on the left, with what is saved in them.

edit.title: Editing
edit.body: In the inspector you rename the choice, move a plan or delete it – the arrows in the status bar take that back.

open.title: Opening
open.body: “Open” at the bottom right takes the choice into the workspace, a room template as a new room of the class.

history.title: History
history.body: “Recent mixes” and “Neighbourhoods” show the last 20 mixes and who has sat side by side, across all rooms.

add.title: Creating
add.body: Create classes, rooms, room templates and presets in the toolbar; “Room template from file …” and “Preset from file …” bring them in from a colleague’s file.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: “Save as file” in a room template’s or a preset’s inspector writes a file without student data – for colleagues or another device.

present.teacherViewTitle: Show the seating chart from the teacher's view
present.studentViewTitle: Show the seating chart from the class's view – without markers and photos
present.badgesTitle: Show or hide student marker icons
present.featuresTitle: Show or hide room elements (board, windows, doors, furniture)
present.zoomTitle: Zoom the view in or out
present.empty: No seating chart to present yet.
present.pickTitle: Draw a random student – everyone gets one turn (Space)
present.contrastTitle: Contrast mode: black on white, thicker outlines

absent.clearTitle: Everybody is back – the marks last for today only and are never stored

circleView.generatingHint: The seating circle is automatically created based on the table plan.

tableNeighbors.someKept_other: {{count}} of {{total}} pairs sit side by side in the circle too.

backupReminder.aged_one: Your last backup is {{count}} day old.
backupReminder.aged_other: Your last backup is {{count}} days old.
backupReminder.never: You have not created a backup yet.
backupReminder.why: Klassenplan stores the data in this browser only. Clearing the browser storage, switching devices or not visiting the site for a few weeks can take the data with it. A backup is the only copy.
backupReminder.faqLink: Moving your data to a new device

markerReview.stale_one: The markers of {{count}} student have not changed for more than {{weeks}} weeks.
markerReview.stale_other: The markers of {{count}} students have not changed for more than {{weeks}} weeks.
markerReview.why: Markers describe how someone behaves right now, and children change. Do they still hold?
markerReview.rowHint: After {{weeks}} weeks without a change, the seating plan asks whether the markers still hold.

cookieConsent.message: This website stores necessary information locally in your browser. No cookies are used and no data is transmitted to servers. More information in our

neighbors.emptyHint: As soon as you present, print, export or name-save a seating chart, it is counted here. Mixing alone does not count.
neighbors.emptyHintManual: Automatic detection is off for this class. Mark a plan as used in the library, and it counts.
neighbors.resetTitle: Forget all neighbourhoods so far and count afresh from now
neighbors.emptyStudent: {{name}} has not sat next to anyone in the counted plans yet.

emptyState.title: Add a Class!
emptyState.description: After adding a class, you can use all actions to manage students.
emptyState.step1: Give your class a name – you can add the school year and notes in the inspector afterwards.
emptyState.hint: You can create as many classes as you like and switch between them.
emptyState.importHint: Restore previously backed up classes, students, and seating plans.

classPanel.name: Name
classPanel.nameTaken: Another class already has this name.

recipes.title: Preset

standard.label: Default
standard.desc: Every criterion this class has data for, at its basic setting.

quietWork.label: Quiet work
quietWork.desc: Separates disturbing factors: restlessness, distractibility, conflicts.

groupWork.label: Group work
groupWork.desc: Wish partners, peer support and language mixing at one table.

exam.label: Written test
exam.desc: As much distance as possible: wishes do not count.

newClass.label: Getting to know each other
newClass.desc: Mix a lot, leave nobody sitting alone, spread the roles around the room.

recipes.allOff: No criterion – the students are placed at random.
recipes.name: Preset name
recipes.nameTaken: Another preset already has this name.
recipes.limit: At most {{count}} presets of your own – delete one to save a new one.
recipes.deleteDetail: The criteria of your classes stay as they are.

importance.offHint: Plays no part in the mix.
importance.considerHint: Taken into account where it fits.
importance.importantHint: Counts clearly, but yields to what matters more.
importance.essentialHint: Takes precedence over the other criteria.

hints.title: Notes
hints.frontRow_one: {{count}} student needs a front seat, the front row has {{seats}} seats: whoever does not fit sits in the row behind.
hints.frontRow_other: {{count}} students need a front seat, the front row has {{seats}} seats: whoever does not fit sits in the row behind.
hints.avoidGroup_one: {{names}} have distance requests among each other, but there is only {{count}} table in the mix: not all of them can sit apart.
hints.avoidGroup_other: {{names}} have distance requests among each other, but there are only {{count}} tables in the mix: not all of them can sit apart.
hints.wishMeetsAvoid: {{wisher}} wishes for {{avoider}}, but {{avoider}} has a distance request for {{wisher}}: the distance request comes first.
hints.wishedOften_one: {{name}} is wished for by {{count}} classmate, but in this room at most {{room}} sit directly around anyone.
hints.wishedOften_other: {{name}} is wished for by {{count}} classmates, but in this room at most {{room}} sit directly around anyone.

avoidPreviousPairs.label: Repetition
avoidPreviousPairs.desc: Separate students who sat next to each other last time

avoidShyAlone.label: Shyness
avoidShyAlone.desc: Don't let students with withdrawn behavior sit alone

peerTutoring.label: Support (heterogeneous)
peerTutoring.desc: Pair students with different performance levels together

homogeneousPerformanceGroups.label: Support (homogeneous)
homogeneousPerformanceGroups.desc: Group students with a similar performance level together

preferFrontForNeedsFrontSeat.label: Front seats
preferFrontForNeedsFrontSeat.desc: Students who should sit at the front

preferFrontForSmallerStudents.label: Height
preferFrontForSmallerStudents.desc: Shorter students front, taller students back

preferWindowSeats.label: Window Seats
preferWindowSeats.desc: Place students who want a window seat nearer the window

preferDoorSeats.label: Door Proximity
preferDoorSeats.desc: Place students who want to sit near the door close to a door

keepNeighbourSeatFree.label: Free Seat Beside
keepNeighbourSeatFree.desc: Keep the seat beside students who need it free

seatLeftHandersLeft.label: Left-Handers
seatLeftHandersLeft.desc: Seat nobody who writes with the right hand to the left of a left-hander

preferLanguageMixing.label: Language support
preferLanguageMixing.desc: Seat students with strong language skills next to beginners/language learners

distributeSocialRoles.label: Social roles
distributeSocialRoles.desc: Distribute social roles across the tables

unavailable.considerWishPartners: No student has a preferred partner
unavailable.avoidConflictPartners: No student has a distance request
unavailable.avoidRestlessTogether: Fewer than 2 students are marked as restless
unavailable.avoidConcentrationTogether: Only works from 2 students with concentration issues – or from one, if at least one student is restless
unavailable.avoidConcentrationNearRestless: Only works with at least one restless and one easily distracted student
unavailable.preferGenderMix: At least two different genders required
unavailable.avoidShyAlone: No student is marked as shy
unavailable.performanceLevels: No students with a performance level
unavailable.preferFrontForNeedsFrontSeat: No student needs a front seat
unavailable.preferWindowSeats: No student prefers a window seat
unavailable.preferDoorSeats: No student prefers to sit near the door
unavailable.keepNeighbourSeatFree: No student needs the seat beside them free
unavailable.preferLanguageMixing: At least 2 different language levels are required
unavailable.distributeSocialRoles: No students with a social role

descriptions.students_step: Go to the previous or next student in the inspector
descriptions.layout_setUpRoom: Set up the room: show tables and templates in the inspector

descriptions.students_redo: Redo a change to the class list

descriptions.library_folders: Into a folder and out again
descriptions.library_menu: Open the menu of the entry
descriptions.library_back: Back to where you came from

demoClass.label: For trying out
demoClass.notes: Invented students with photos. You can delete this class at any time from the class switcher.
demoClass.hint: 24 invented students with photos and a furnished classroom for trying things out.
demoClass.emptyClassPrompt: Rather try it out first? Load the sample class.
demoClass.emptyClassSwitchPrompt: The sample class is already there.
demoClass.addMenuHint: Creates a separate class with 24 invented students – your class stays as it is.
demoClass.addMenuSwitchHint: Opens the sample class – your class stays as it is.

help.title: Help and tour
help.body: A short guide here explains what you are looking at. Under “More help” you restart this tour and find the FAQ and the shortcuts.

sidebarToggle.title: Expand and collapse the toolbar
sidebarToggle.body: Collapsed, the toolbar shows only icons; expanded, their names too.

emptyState.title: Welcome to Klassenplan!
emptyState.body: Create your first class – or load the sample class and try everything with invented students first.

backup.title: Back up your data
backup.body: “Backup” exports your data encrypted and restores it – in another browser or on another device, too.

proceed.title: On to the room
proceed.body: Once the list is complete, set up the classroom in the next step.

library.title: Library
library.body: Your classes, room templates and presets are kept here, with everything saved in them – rooms, plans and the recent mixes.

proceed.title: On to the seating plan
proceed.body: The first time it opens, Klassenplan mixes a seating plan for you.

circle.title: Seating plan and circle
circle.body: Switch between the seating plan and the seating circle here. The circle is built from the plan and saved with it.

exits.title: Present and export
exits.body: Present the plan on the board or export it – both save it if you have changed anything since.

mix.title: Mix
mix.body: Mixes the class again by the criteria in the inspector; locked seats keep their students.

shell.unsavedRetry: Changes not saved – try again now
shell.teachersDay: Today is World Teachers' Day: thank you for your work!

sceneInspector.title: Properties
sceneInspector.setupHint: Places as many tables of the chosen kind as your class needs.
sceneInspector.setupReplaceHint: Your room is set up from scratch with the respective tables.
sceneInspector.setupNoStudents: Add students to the class first.
sceneInspector.templatesHint: Save this room as a template to use it for other classes as well.
sceneInspector.roomNameTaken: A room of this class already has this name.
sceneInspector.inMixMixed: In the mix – only part of the selection
sceneInspector.inMixOffHint_one: Stays empty when mixing. You can still seat someone here by hand.
sceneInspector.inMixOffHint_other: Stay empty when mixing. You can still seat someone here by hand.
sceneInspector.fillFromFrontHint: With more seats than students, the seats at the back stay free.

planSave.nameTaken: Another plan already has this name.

whoIsNext.title: Who's next?
whoIsNext.emptyBody: Create a class with students first.

round.title: One round
round.body: Everyone gets one turn before anyone repeats; then the next round starts.

skip.title: Skip
skip.body: Draws someone else – whoever was skipped stays in the round.

reset.title: Start over
reset.body: “Start over” or Esc begins a new round, Space draws.

seatFinder.title: Where does who sit?
seatFinder.noMatch: Nobody in this plan is called “{{query}}”.
seatFinder.emptyBody: This view reads the current seating plan. Mix one, and it will say who sits where.

search.title: Searching
search.body: Type a name – once only one is left, it opens by itself.

seat.title: Seat
seat.body: The plan lights up the student's seat.

groups.title: Build groups
groups.conflict: Not kept apart: {{names}}. There are not enough groups for that.
groups.emptyBody: Create a class with students first.

draw.title: Drawing groups
draw.body: Every draw makes new groups of the chosen size.

avoid.title: Distance partners
avoid.body: Students with a distance partner end up in different groups where possible.

plan.title: Seating plan
plan.body: The groups leave the seating plan as it is.

duties.title: Hand out duties
duties.hint: From {{total}} students — tap “Hand out duties” below.
duties.shortfall_one: The class has {{total}} students — {{count}} place stays open.
duties.shortfall_other: The class has {{total}} students — {{count}} places stay open.
duties.emptyBody: Create a class with students first.

fair.title: Fair turns
fair.body: Whoever has had the fewest duties so far goes first; nobody gets more than one per round.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.body: “Next round” counts the distribution and hands out the next one, “Draw again” hands out the same round once more.

replace.title: Someone is away
replace.body: The arrows beside a name give that duty to someone else.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: The duties and the last 20 rounds stay with the class and are part of the backup.

library.openHintNothing: Choose a class, a room, a plan or a mix.
library.openHintFolder: Choose what to open inside it.
library.openHintNeighbours: Neighbourhoods can only be read, not opened.
library.emptyRoom: No plan in this room yet.
library.emptyTemplates: No template yet. Add one in the toolbar or save a room as a template.
library.emptyNeighbours: No students in this class yet.
library.neighboursHint: Choose a student: the next column shows whom they sat next to, most often first.
library.neighbourStudentHint: The next column shows whom {{name}} sat next to, most often first.
library.nothingSelected: Choose a class, a room or a plan on the left.
library.mixesHint: Klassenplan keeps the last 20 mixes of a class. Each names the room it was made in.
library.templatesHint: Templates belong to every class. A template opens as a new room of the open class.

room.saveAsTemplate: Save as a template for other classes
room.deleteOpenHint: The open room cannot be deleted. Open another one first.
room.deleteLastHint: A class keeps at least one room.

plan.usedHint: A plan in use counts towards the neighbourhoods: who sat next to each other in it is kept apart as far as possible when mixing with the “Repetition” criterion switched on.
plan.detectOn: Applies to every plan of this class: a plan counts as used as soon as you present it, export it or save it under a name of its own.
plan.detectOff: Applies to every plan of this class: only the plans you mark as used yourself count.
plan.otherTables: This plan has other tables than “{{room}}”. Does it belong in a room of its own?

template.hint: “Open as a room” at the bottom right adds this template as a new room of the open class.
template.emptyHint: No tables yet. Open the template as a room, place the tables and replace it there in the inspector under “Templates”.

library.presetsHint: Presets apply to every class. You add your own in the toolbar or save them in the plan under “Preset”; “Apply” sets the criteria of the open class.

preset.hint: Every change applies to the preset at once. “Apply” at the bottom right sets the criteria of the open class to it; nothing is mixed until you mix.
preset.standardHint: “Default” stays as it is – the way back to the basic settings. You can change the other presets and your own.

share.templateMessage: It joins your room templates; what is already there stays.
share.presetMessage: It joins your presets; what is already there stays.
